risks.risk: Mismatch between what’s listed and what’s actually included (drive shafts, steering rack/gear, starter motor may not be present).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of each item laid out separately: (1) both drive shafts with CV ends visible, (2) steering rack/gear with mounting points visible, (3) starter motor with label/part number area visible, (4) radiator/condenser end tanks visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as 'scrap/unknown mixed car parts' with only the radiator/condenser confirmed.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment (vehicle make/model/year) for the steering/suspension/axle parts.
risks.proof: Ask for the donor vehicle details (make/model/year) or part numbers stamped on the parts; request close-up photos of any markings on the shafts/rack/starter.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as 'non-guaranteed fitment' scrap value.

risks.risk: Radiator/condenser may be damaged/leaking or missing end tanks/fittings.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the radiator/condenser: both end tanks, inlet/outlet areas, and any visible dents/holes; plus a quick water-fill/leak test video if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as 'damaged/untested radiator' (not serviceable).

risks.risk: Condition of rubber boots/bushings and internal components (steering/suspension parts) may be heavily worn or seized.
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of rubber boots (tears/cracks), and photos of mounting points/shafts; request a short video showing any free movement where applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as 'for parts only' with no functional guarantee.
